figmaOnlyProps.Avatar.type: Code picks image or initials from whether src loads; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Checkbox.checked: Base UI's checked and indeterminate props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.view: Which page is open is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.preview: Code shows the pane when an item has preview content; Figma toggles it.

codeOnlyProps.reactions.position: Which viewport corner the floating bar pins to; Figma shows the bar on its own.
